title: Mixture-Greedy for Online Generative Model Selection: Is UCB Necessary in Diversity-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits?
abstract: arXiv:2603.21716v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient selection among multiple generative models is increasingly important in modern generative AI, where sampling from suboptimal models is costly. This problem can be viewed as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) task. Under diversity-aware evaluation scores, a non-degenerate mixture of generators can outperform any individual model, distinguishing this MAB setting from classical best-arm identification. Prior approaches incorporate an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) exploration bonus into the mixture objective. However, across multiple datasets and evaluation metrics, we observe that the UCB term consistently slows convergence and reduces sample efficiency. In contrast, a simple Mixture-Greedy strategy without explicit UCB-type optimism converges faster and achieves even better performance, particularly for widely used metrics such as FID and Vendi where tight confidence bounds are difficult to construct. translated_title: 面向在线生成模型选择的混合贪心策略：在多样性感知的多臂老虎机中UCB是否必要？
translated_abstract: 在现代生成式AI中，如何在多个生成模型之间进行高效选择变得越来越重要，因为从次优模型中采样的代价很高。该问题可以被视为一个多臂老虎机（MAB）任务。在多样性感知的评估分数下，生成器的非退化混合可以优于任何单个模型，这使得该MAB设置与经典的最佳臂识别问题区别开来。先前的方法在混合目标中引入了置信上界（UCB）探索奖励。然而，在多个数据集和评估指标上，我们观察到UCB项始终会减慢收敛速度并降低样本效率。相比之下，一种简单的、不包含显式UCB类乐观主义的Mixture-Greedy（混合贪心）策略收敛更快，并取得了更好的性能，尤其是对于FID和Vendi这类广泛使用但难以构造紧致置信界的指标。我们提供了理论见解……
tldr: 本文提出Mixture-Greedy策略，并发现在多样性感知的多臂老虎机生成模型选择问题中，UCB探索奖励并非必要——去除UCB反而收敛更快、样本效率更高、性能更好。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mixture-Greedy strategy and shows that UCB exploration bonuses are unnecessary in diversity-aware multi-armed bandits for generative model selection—removing UCB leads to faster convergence, higher sample efficiency, and better performance.
